def VTask.subtypePreimage {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) :
  { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) :=
begin
  -- Define the forward direction of the equivalence
  def f (x : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }) : { a // ¬p a } → β :=
    λ a, match a.property with
         | Or.inl h := x.val a
         | Or.inr h := x₀ ⟨a, h⟩

  -- Define the inverse direction of the equivalence
  def g (y : { a // ¬p a } → β) : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } :=
    λ _, { val := λ a, match p a with
             | true := y ⟨a, decTrivial⟩
             | false := x₀ ⟨a, decTrivial⟩ }

  -- Prove that f and g are inverses
  def f_inv_g (y : { a // ¬p a } → β) : f (g y) = y :=
    funext $ λ a, match a.property with
                  | Or.inl h := y a
                  | Or.inr h := y a

  def g_inv_f (x : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }) : g (f x) = x :=
    funext $ λ a, match p a with
                  | true := x.val a
                  | false := x.val a

  -- Return the equivalence
  return Equiv.mk f g f_inv_g g_inv_f
end
